items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was on the road without, uh, with, uh, Horace Hite after a while. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh.

ctx.x: Uh, except I, I don't remember if the Jefferson City Buzzards and those marching groups sometimes used them or not. I think they had black brass bands. I remember black brass bands. I don't remember white brass bands. But then, of course, there were, there were a lot of, there was a lot of interest in the high schools, in the, in the white high schools, in, uh, in band music. Yeah. And the high school I went to was, had, the bands have made high state ratings for many years. Mm-hmm. And, uh, in fact, what's his…
He was on the road without, uh, with, uh, Horace Hite after a while.
